items.source: When the prompt options do not implement ToolCallingChatOptions (e.g. for models that don't support tool calling), this advisor passes the request through to the next advisor without modification.
items.translation: 当提示选项未实现ToolCallingChatOptions接口（例如，对于不支持工具调用的模型）时，该顾问会将请求原样传递给下一个顾问。

items.source: It uses the CallAdvisorChainUtil to implement looping advisor chain calls.
items.translation: 它使用 CallAdvisorChainUtil 来实现循环顾问链调用。

items.source:
This enables intercepting the tool calling loop by the rest of the advisors next in the
chain.
items.translation: 这使得链中后续的顾问能够拦截工具调用循环。

items.source: Default advisor order. Higher than Advisor.DEFAULT_CHAT_MEMORY_PRECEDENCE_ORDER (+200) so that memory advisors at their default order are placed outside this advisor and do not participate in each tool-call iteration.
items.translation: 默认顾问顺序。高于 Advisor.DEFAULT_CHAT_MEMORY_PRECEDENCE_ORDER（+200），因此按默认顺序设置的记忆顾问会位于此顾问之外，不参与每次工具调用迭代。

items.source:
Hook method called at the start of the streaming tool call loop. Subclasses can
override to customize initialization behavior.
items.translation: 在流式工具调用循环开始时调用的钩子方法。子类可以重写它以自定义初始化行为。

items.source:
Hook method called before each streaming call in the tool call loop. Subclasses can
override to customize pre-call behavior.
items.translation: 在工具调用循环中的每个流式调用之前会调用 Hook 方法。子类可以重写此方法以自定义预调用行为。

items.source:
Hook method called after each streaming call in the tool call loop. Subclasses can
override to customize post-call behavior.
items.translation: 在工具调用循环中的每次流式调用后都会调用 Hook 方法。子类可以重写此方法以自定义调用后的行为。

items.source:
Hook method called at the end of the streaming tool call loop to finalize the
response. Subclasses can override to customize finalization behavior.
items.translation: 在流式工具调用循环结束时调用的钩子方法，用于完成响应。子类可以重写此方法以自定义完成行为。

items.source:
Hook method to determine the next instructions for a tool call iteration in
streaming mode. Subclasses can override to customize conversation history handling.
items.translation: 用于在流式模式下确定工具调用迭代中下一条指令的钩子方法。子类可重写此方法以自定义对话历史处理逻辑。

items.source:
Recursive Advisor that disables the internal tool execution flow and instead implements
the tool calling loop as part of the advisor chain.
items.translation: 递归顾问，该顾问禁用内部工具执行流程，并将工具调用循环作为顾问链的一部分实现。
